answer: Farming becomes a falcon bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every sonnet settlement recomputes the river schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
